execution.scope: Supplied coherent controls distinguish the two characters; bare C/E records do not select either.

all_finite_history_identity.map: K_h=sqrt(w_h) sum_(x in D_h) chi_h(x)|f_h(x)><x|, with injective f_h
all_finite_history_identity.same_history_effect: K_h* K_h=w_h P_Dh for both characters

complete_channel_distances.identification: fixed sorted-pair amplitude chart, with the same input state for both lifts
complete_channel_distances.metric: one half diamond norm of complete source-plus-classical-record channels

one_attempt_witness.input: equal positive coherent superposition of the two displayed pairs

negative_controls.dephase_input: both lifts give plus and minus probability 1/2
negative_controls.read_only_native_records: both laws and both lifts have identical distributions

one_attempt_witness.read: record-selected inverse movement, then X on the two input addresses

rotation_and_chart_covariance.chart_rule: s'_xy=g_y s_xy g_x; K'_h=G K_h G*
rotation_and_chart_covariance.gauge_obstruction: A diagonal endpoint gauge has unit product around every loop; the exchange product is -1.

continuous_character_witness.flat_on_original_domain_only_when: theta is an integer multiple of 2*pi
